structured_output.mechanisms: Time is roughly steps × per-step cost. Per-step cost scales with conv FLOPs (stage widths, weighted by resolution) plus a fixed part, and with batch size. A low-resolution phase cuts step cost in proportion to its step fraction. Accuracy rises with epochs and capacity. Cutout, high label smoothing, random flip and low-res phases each cost accuracy. Interactions: the width and epoch tradeoff, and the speed and accuracy tradeoff of the resolution curriculum.
